roofing.name: Hardtland Home Improvement
roofing.description: A family-run Madison & Verona roofer since 1972. Their old site was one page with no headline, no pages for their services or towns, and a slow mobile load. We rebuilt it as a 22-page roofing website that shows homeowners everything they check before they call.
improvements: Mobile speed score 51 → 100 and accessibility 53 → 100 (Google Lighthouse)
1 page → 22 pages: 8 service pages, 6 town pages, reviews, about, gallery, insurance and FAQ
Google rating, years in business, certifications and a free-inspection button on the first screen
roofing.note: Google Lighthouse (simulated mobile), November 2026: old homepage vs. the new site. Scores vary between runs.
